{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
missing_age = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type of customer_age
type_age = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 999, etc.)
sentinel_values = sales_df['customer_age'].isin([-1, 0, 999, 9999]).sum()

missing_age, type_age, sentinel_values"}
